research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Cerrion is engaged in research and development of a monitoring system for a container glass forming machine, as described in 'Monitoring system for a container glass forming machine.' This system includes a data acquisition and analyzing unit with at least one sensor, managed by software, to monitor and analyze production processes. Cerrion’s focus is on computer vision-driven production insights for glass manufacturing operations.

overview_description.description: Cerrion is a visual AI that helps production teams react faster to process deviations, automate root cause analysis, and implement targeted improvement actions. They believe that process transparency enabled by AI and computer vision is key to achieving more autonomy and sustainability in manufacturing. Their software is built and designed with production teams from all over the world in the loop.

about_short_description.short_description: Cerrion is an AI software company that develops computer vision technology to generate production insights.

product.name: Process Fault AI
product.description: Monitors critical production areas using video AI to learn normal processes and detect deviations in real-time.

product.name: Downtime AI
product.description: Automatically monitors machines to detect and track all downtime events using video AI.

product.name: Line Buffer AI
product.description: Monitors line buffers and accumulation tables to track fill levels using video AI.

product.name: Line Speed AI
product.description: Monitors line bottlenecks and tracks real line speed, detecting deviations from benchmarks in real-time using video AI.

product.name: Line Output AI
product.description: Detects and counts line output, identifying deviations from benchmarks in real-time using video AI.
